description: Run payment operations on Modern Treasury: create and track payment orders, keep counterparties and their bank accounts, tell Modern Treasury which payments to expect, read incoming payments, keep ledgers, and start a workflow when a payment is created, changes status or arrives.

modern_treasury_new_counterparty_trigger.description: Runs when a counterparty is added in Modern Treasury, with its name and email. Counterparties already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.name: Its name
output.record: The whole record, as Modern Treasury sent it
output.verification_status: Whether Modern Treasury has verified it

modern_treasury_new_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new entry in Modern Treasury's event log (a payment order completed, an expected payment reconciled and so on), optionally only for one kind of record or event, with the record as it was at that moment. Events already logged when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.data: The record as it was at that moment
output.entity_id: The id of the record it is about
output.event_name: What happened, such as completed or failed
output.record: The whole record, as Modern Treasury sent it
output.resource: The kind of record, such as payment_order

parameters.description: Only events about this kind of record: payment_order, incoming_payment_detail, expected_payment, transaction, counterparty, external_account, internal_account, ledger_transaction, ledger_account, return, reversal or balance_report. Leave blank for every kind.
parameters.name: resource

parameters.description: Only this event, such as completed, failed, created, approved or cancelled. Leave blank for every event.
parameters.name: event_name

modern_treasury_new_incoming_payment_tri.description: Runs when money arrives in one of your accounts in Modern Treasury, with its amount, type, account and sender. Payments already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.amount: The amount in the currency's smallest unit (cents for USD)
output.originating_party_name: Who sent it, when the bank says
output.reconciliation_status: Whether it is matched to an expected payment
output.record: The whole record, as Modern Treasury sent it
output.type: How it arrived: ach, wire, rtp and so on

modern_treasury_new_payment_order_trigge.description: Runs when a payment order is created in Modern Treasury, from the dashboard, the API or Lodol, with its type, amount, accounts and status. Payment orders already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.amount: The amount in the currency's smallest unit (cents for USD)
output.record: The whole record, as Modern Treasury sent it
output.status: Its status, such as processing, completed or failed
output.type: How it moves: ach, wire, rtp and so on
output.vendor_failure_reason: Why the bank failed it, if it failed

modern_treasury_payment_order_status_tri.description: Runs each time a payment order reaches a new status in Modern Treasury (approved, processing, completed, failed and so on), once per status. Changes made before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.amount: The amount in the currency's smallest unit (cents for USD)
output.record: The whole record, as Modern Treasury sent it
output.status: Its status, such as processing, completed or failed
output.type: How it moves: ach, wire, rtp and so on
output.vendor_failure_reason: Why the bank failed it, if it failed

parameters.description: Only when a payment order reaches this status: approved, cancelled, completed, denied, failed, needs_approval, pending, processing, returned, reversed or sent. Leave blank for every change.
parameters.name: status
